title: Part Eleven: Rome and the Rothschilds: What the Documents Show

sections.brief: Torlonia as papal banker (1794-); the 1831-32 Rothschild-Torlonia loan after the 1831 revolts (Felisini; Rothschild Archive: five loans 1831-1850; JE loan table 1831, 1845); the 1834 Tosti episode; Antonelli's 1850s borrowing (Pollard); end of the Naples house and of the Papal States; the 'exclusivity clause' traced to Balla 1913 and graded; Vigny, Belli, Börne, Union Générale, Drumont, JE 1906 and how 'the Rothschilds control the Pope' became an antisemitic trope; Orsini linked to vt7. Figures: fig-time

The '1831-2026, no documented breaks' chain tested link by link: loans to 1850s, Naples closed 1863, 1870, JE 1906 sentence, 1929 money and Nogara's Special Administration, IOR 1942/1990, Sindona, Ambrosiano, de Franssu 2014, Pauly 2026; where documents stop. Figures: fig-compare (claim vs document)

Pauly's appointment (Dec 2025 proposal, 28 Jan 2026 approval, 25 Mar announcement, 28 Apr handover, in office by 11 May), his CV as the IOR, UBP, Option Finance and InfoVaticana give it (Edmond de Rothschild 2021-2023, distinct from Rothschild & Co); de Franssu's earlier career; the PNF release of 24 March 2026 on Fabrice Aidan (preliminary inquiry, not charged) and Reuters on his denial; no link to the IOR; status as of October 2026. Figures: fig-time, fig-compare
